1: /**
2:  * The wire contract for agent-composed UI.
3:  *
4:  * A payload is a tree of `{ type, props, children }` nodes validated against a
5:  * catalog manifest. The manifest is plain JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 subset),
6:  * so the same document can be handed to the model as a tool schema and used
7:  * here to validate what comes back. Nothing is eval'd, no HTML is injected, and
8:  * every node is bounded before it can reach React.
9:  *
10:  * Parsing is deliberately forgiving where it is safe (unknown props are
11:  * stripped, unknown component types degrade to a visible fallback) and strict
12:  * where it matters (structure, required props, and size ceilings).
13:  */
14: 
15: export const UI_LIMITS = {
16:   maxDepth: 12,
17:   maxNodes: 200,
18:   maxStringLength: 2000,
19:   maxChildren: 32,
20:   maxActions: 40,
21: } as const;
22: 
23: /** A JSON Schema subset: enough to describe every prop in the catalog. */
24: export interface UiPropSchema {
25:   type?: "string" | "number" | "integer" | "boolean" | "array" | "object";
26:   description?: string;
27:   enum?: readonly string[];
28:   minimum?: number;
29:   maximum?: number;
30:   items?: UiPropSchema;
31:   properties?: Record<string, UiPropSchema>;
32:   required?: readonly string[];
33:   minItems?: number;
34:   maxItems?: number;
35: }
36: 
37: export interface UiCatalogEntry {
38:   type: string;
39:   kind: "layout" | "leaf";
40:   description: string;
41:   acceptsChildren: boolean;
42:   props: UiPropSchema;
43: }
44: 
45: export interface UiCatalogManifest {
46:   version: 1;
47:   components: UiCatalogEntry[];
48: }
49: 
50: export interface UiNode {
51:   type: string;
52:   props: Record<string, unknown>;
53:   children: UiNode[];
54:   /** Set when the manifest has no component for this type. */
55:   unsupported?: boolean;
56: }
57: 
58: export type ParseResult = { ok: true; node: UiNode } | { ok: false; reason: string };
59: 
60: type ValueResult = { ok: true; value: unknown } | { ok: false };
61: 
62: interface ParseState {
63:   entries: Map<string, UiCatalogEntry>;
64:   nodes: number;
65: }
66: 
67: function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
68:   return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
69: }
70: 
71: export function catalogIndex(manifest: UiCatalogManifest): Map<string, UiCatalogEntry> {
72:   return new Map(manifest.components.map((entry) => [entry.type, entry]));
73: }
74: 
75: function ok(value: unknown): ValueResult {
76:   return { ok: true, value };
77: }
78: 
79: const INVALID: ValueResult = { ok: false };
80: 
81: function validateValue(raw: unknown, schema: UiPropSchema, depth: number): ValueResult {
82:   if (depth > UI_LIMITS.maxDepth + 4) {
83:     return INVALID;
84:   }
85: 
86:   if (schema.enum) {
87:     return typeof raw === "string" && schema.enum.includes(raw) ? ok(raw) : INVALID;
88:   }
89: 
90:   switch (schema.type) {
91:     case "string":
92:       if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.length > UI_LIMITS.maxStringLength) {
93:         return INVALID;
94:       }
95:       return ok(raw);
96: 
97:     case "number":
98:     case "integer": {
99:       if (typeof raw !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(raw)) {
100:         return INVALID;
101:       }
102:       if (schema.type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(raw)) {
103:         return INVALID;
104:       }
105:       if (schema.minimum !== undefined && raw < schema.minimum) {
106:         return INVALID;
107:       }
108:       if (schema.maximum !== undefined && raw > schema.maximum) {
109:         return INVALID;
110:       }
111:       return ok(raw);
112:     }
113: 
114:     case "boolean":
115:       return typeof raw === "boolean" ? ok(raw) : INVALID;
116: 
117:     case "array": {
118:       if (!Array.isArray(raw)) {
119:         return INVALID;
120:       }
121:       if (schema.minItems !== undefined && raw.length < schema.minItems) {
122:         return INVALID;
123:       }
124:       if (schema.maxItems !== undefined && raw.length > schema.maxItems) {
125:         return INVALID;
126:       }
127:       const items: unknown[] = [];
128:       for (const entry of raw) {
129:         const validated = schema.items ? validateValue(entry, schema.items, depth + 1) : ok(entry);
130:         if (!validated.ok) {
131:           return INVALID;
132:         }
133:         items.push(validated.value);
134:       }
135:       return ok(items);
136:     }
137: 
138:     case "object": {
139:       if (!isPlainObject(raw)) {
140:         return INVALID;
141:       }
142:       const result = validateProps(raw, schema, depth + 1);
143:       return result.ok ? ok(result.value) : INVALID;
144:     }
145: 
146:     default:
147:       return INVALID;
148:   }
149: }
150: 
151: function validateProps(
152:   raw: Record<string, unknown>,
153:   schema: UiPropSchema,
154:   depth: number,
155: ): { ok: true; value: Record<string, unknown> } | { ok: false } {
156:   const properties = schema.properties ?? {};
157:   const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
158: 
159:   for (const key of schema.required ?? []) {
160:     if (!(key in raw)) {
161:       return { ok: false };
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
166:     const propertySchema = properties[key];
167:     if (!propertySchema) {
168:       // Unknown props are stripped rather than trusted.
169:       continue;
170:     }
171:     const validated = validateValue(value, propertySchema, depth);
172:     if (!validated.ok) {
173:       if ((schema.required ?? []).includes(key)) {
174:         return { ok: false };
175:       }
176:       continue;
177:     }
178:     result[key] = validated.value;
179:   }
180: 
181:   return { ok: true, value: result };
182: }
183: 
184: function describePropFailure(entry: UiCatalogEntry, key: string): string {
185:   const schema = entry.props.properties?.[key];
186:   if (!schema) {
187:     return `unknown prop "${key}"`;
188:   }
189:   if (schema.enum) {
190:     return `prop "${key}" must be one of ${schema.enum.join(", ")}`;
191:   }
192:   if (schema.type === "number" || schema.type === "integer") {
193:     const bounds =
194:       schema.minimum !== undefined || schema.maximum !== undefined
195:         ? ` between ${schema.minimum ?? "-∞"} and ${schema.maximum ?? "∞"}`
196:         : "";
197:     return `prop "${key}" must be a ${schema.type}${bounds}`;
198:   }
199:   if (schema.type === "array") {
200:     return `prop "${key}" must be an array of valid items`;
201:   }
202:   if (schema.type === "object") {
203:     return `prop "${key}" must be an object with the documented fields`;
204:   }
205:   if (schema.type === "boolean") {
206:     return `prop "${key}" must be a boolean`;
207:   }
208:   return `prop "${key}" must be a ${schema.type ?? "valid value"}`;
209: }
210: 
211: function parseNode(raw: unknown, depth: number, state: ParseState): ParseResult {
212:   if (depth > UI_LIMITS.maxDepth) {
213:     return { ok: false, reason: `UI tree exceeds the maximum depth of ${UI_LIMITS.maxDepth}` };
214:   }
215:   state.nodes += 1;
216:   if (state.nodes > UI_LIMITS.maxNodes) {
217:     return { ok: false, reason: `UI tree exceeds the maximum of ${UI_LIMITS.maxNodes} nodes` };
218:   }
219: 
220:   if (!isPlainObject(raw)) {
221:     return { ok: false, reason: "UI node must be an object" };
222:   }
223: 
224:   const type = raw.type;
225:   if (typeof type !== "string" || type.trim() === "" || type.length > 100) {
226:     return { ok: false, reason: "UI node needs a component type" };
227:   }
228: 
229:   if (raw.props !== undefined && !isPlainObject(raw.props)) {
230:     return { ok: false, reason: `UI node "${type}" has non-object props` };
231:   }
232:   if (raw.children !== undefined && !Array.isArray(raw.children)) {
233:     return { ok: false, reason: `UI node "${type}" has non-array children` };
234:   }
235: 
236:   const entry = state.entries.get(type);
237:   if (!entry) {
238:     return { ok: true, node: { type, props: {}, children: [], unsupported: true } };
239:   }
240: 
241:   const props = validateProps(isPlainObject(raw.props) ? raw.props : {}, entry.props, 0);
242:   if (!props.ok) {
243:     const failed = Object.keys(entry.props.properties ?? {}).find((key) => {
244:       const schema = entry.props.properties?.[key];
245:       const value = isPlainObject(raw.props) ? raw.props[key] : undefined;
246:       if (!(entry.props.required ?? []).includes(key)) {
247:         return false;
248:       }
249:       return !schema || !validateValue(value, schema, 0).ok;
250:     });
251:     return {
252:       ok: false,
253:       reason: failed
254:         ? `${type}: ${describePropFailure(entry, failed)}`
255:         : `${type}: props failed validation`,
256:     };
257:   }
258: 
259:   const rawChildren = Array.isArray(raw.children) ? raw.children : [];
260:   const children: UiNode[] = [];
261: 
262:   if (entry.acceptsChildren) {
263:     if (rawChildren.length > UI_LIMITS.maxChildren) {
264:       return {
265:         ok: false,
266:         reason: `${type} accepts at most ${UI_LIMITS.maxChildren} children`,
267:       };
268:     }
269:     for (const child of rawChildren) {
270:       const parsed = parseNode(child, depth + 1, state);
271:       if (!parsed.ok) {
272:         return parsed;
273:       }
274:       children.push(parsed.node);
275:     }
276:   }
277: 
278:   return { ok: true, node: { type, props: props.value, children } };
279: }
280: 
281: export function parseUiSpec(raw: unknown, manifest: UiCatalogManifest): ParseResult {
282:   return parseNode(raw, 0, {
283:     entries: catalogIndex(manifest),
284:     nodes: 0,
285:   });
286: }
287: 
288: /** Serializable projection of the catalog sent to the sidecar with each turn. */
289: export function toManifest(components: UiCatalogEntry[]): UiCatalogManifest {
290:   return { version: 1, components };
291: }

## Status
